chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But [He granted authority] over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/ally

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying that Satan's *sultan* (authority/power) is not absolute over all believers but is conditional upon their voluntary submission and disobedience to God. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of *Ikhtiyar* (free will), where Satan acts as a tempter rather than a coercer, allowing the faithful to maintain their spiritual autonomy through conscious adherence to divine command.
